description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Ceodore)] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Ceodore)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =25%/50%/75%/100% and 5%/10%/15%/20% additional critical damage for equipped Holy abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Holy Mode II (Ceodore)], removes [Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Ceodore)]
